description: Write one attachment a file embeds (a slide label or thumbnail, a preview image, time stamps) to a new file as stored, verified. openreadout_info view=structure lists them.

attachment.description: The attachment: a name as openreadout_info view=structure lists it (a CZI's `Thumbnail`, `Label` or `SlidePreview` image, `TimeStamps`), or `#<index>`.

file.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative path to the file that holds the attachment.

output.description: Output path. Default: `<input stem>.<attachment name>.<ext>` next to the input.

name: openreadout_extract

AttachmentInfo.description: A file embedded in the container (thumbnail, label image, time stamps, ...).

content_type.description: Content type as the file declares it (e.g. `JPG`, `CZI`, `CZTIMS`).

extension.description: Suggested file extension for the extracted bytes, without the dot.

extra.description: Format-specific details in the reader's documented vocabulary.

name.description: Name as stored in the container (e.g. `Thumbnail`, `Label`).

offset.description: Byte offset of the attachment payload in its file.

format.description: Format id of the input file.

verified.description: True once the output was read back and matched.

xxh3.description: xxh3-128 of the written bytes, 32 hex chars.
